purpose: Teach: 腹痛/蒸し暑い/暖炉/オムツ/饅頭/日陰/雨水/プロポーズ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、最近、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、腹痛、絶対、続いていたのよ
lines.en: Aoi, I'm serious — you've been having stomach trouble lately, haven't you?
lines.style: Direct, concerned but keeping it light. Slight conspiratorial lean. Not a question she expects answered immediately — more an opening to care.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、お店、絶対、蒸し暑い、絶対、日は、絶対、エアコン、絶対、強めにしてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. On the really humid days at the shop, I crank the AC up higher.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, solution-focused. Practical shrug in the voice. Casual and reassuring — not deflecting, just normalizing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店の、本気で、絶対、暖炉、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、冬、絶対、お気に入りよ
lines.en: Your shop's fireplace in winter — I absolutely love sitting there.
lines.style: Warm, nostalgic softness. Slight smile audible. The kind of compliment that lands because it's genuine, not performed. Tender trailing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお友達、本気で、絶対、出産で、絶対、オムツ、絶対、ご贈答品、絶対、考えてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, one of your friends just had a baby — I've been thinking about what to give them for a gift.
lines.style: Animated but grounded. Matter-of-fact warmth. Slight lift on the opening — genuine delight in helping someone else plan something good.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の、本気で、絶対、和菓子、絶対、饅頭、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、大好きよ
lines.en: I really do love your shop's wagashi — especially the manju.
lines.style: Eager and sincere. Light, genuine emphasis on love without overselling it. Like she's been thinking about this and wants Aoi to know it lands.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店の前、本気で、絶対、日陰、絶対、お席、絶対、お客様に、絶対、人気よ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That shaded seating area outside your shop is so popular with customers.
lines.style: Praising with genuine warmth. Observant — she's noticed people choosing it. Pride in her voice for Aoi's thoughtfulness, not over-the-top.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店の屋根、本気で、絶対、雨水、絶対、対策、絶対、大丈夫?メイちゃん
lines.en: Is the roof at your shop okay for rainwater? Are you managing that all right?
lines.style: Caring, slightly worried. Soft opening, then a gentle check-in. Not hovering — just noticing a practical thing and asking because she cares.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お友達、絶対、プロポーズ、絶対、されたって、聞いたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I heard one of your friends got proposed to! That's wonderful.
lines.style: Animated, delighted, genuine. Lift on the news itself. The warmth of being happy about someone else's joy. Quick, bright, eager to celebrate with her.
